Growth Analyst — Lumen Consumer BV

The team
Lumen Consumer runs a subscription app across the Benelux region. Our growth team owns
acquisition, onboarding and retention. We are looking for a Growth Analyst to be the
analytical partner for the paid acquisition and lifecycle marketing managers.

Responsibilities
- Own performance reporting for paid acquisition channels and campaigns.
- Build and maintain retention, churn and reactivation cohorts, and explain movement
  between periods rather than just reporting it.
- Design, size and read out A/B tests on onboarding and lifecycle messaging.
- Translate budget scenarios into expected return, acquisition cost and subscriber
  outcomes, and present the trade-offs to marketing leadership.
- Improve data quality in the marketing stack: tracking, naming conventions and
  attribution definitions.

Requirements
- 3+ years in an analytics role supporting marketing or growth.
- Fluent SQL; comfortable working with event-level data.
- Hands-on experience with a mobile measurement partner and a CRM or engagement platform.
- A track record of turning analysis into a decision that changed spend or messaging.
- Strong stakeholder communication in English.

Nice to have
- Forecasting or scenario modelling experience.
- Familiarity with app analytics tooling.
- Experience in a subscription or marketplace business.

Practicalities
Based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. Hybrid, three days in the office. We support candidates
who need a permit to work in the Netherlands and will discuss sponsorship for the right
applicant.
